title: Nighthawk, Once Again
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Nighthawk was a legendary hitman feared by criminals, but after eight years of retirement she lives in a filthy apartment and spends all her money on gambling and gacha games. Facing eviction with almost no money left, she must decide whether to return to killing.
life_message: Played for comedy, it suggests that a person has to face the mess they have made of their life and find purpose again.
